# What is this?

Simple 7-segment clock. The 12/24-hour format follows your Flipper's system locale.

- Up/Down: screen brightness. At the lowest level, Down toggles a dim red nightlight.
- Right: set a daily alarm (on/off + time). When it goes off the screen flashes ALARM with a melody; any key stops it and it stays armed for the next day.

Alarm and brightness are remembered between launches.
